error.credentials_required: Access key ID and secret access key are required when not using an IAM role.

data_description.access_key_id: Access key ID to connect to AWS S3 API. Leave empty when using an IAM role.
data_description.bucket: Bucket must already exist and be writable by the provided credentials.
data_description.endpoint_url: Endpoint URL provided to [Boto3 Session]({boto3_docs_url}). Region-specific [AWS S3 endpoints]({aws_s3_docs_url}) are available in their docs.
data_description.prefix: Folder or prefix to store backups in, for example `backups`
data_description.secret_access_key: Secret access key to connect to AWS S3 API. Leave empty when using an IAM role.
data_description.use_iam_role: Take credentials from the EC2 instance profile (IMDS) instead of static access keys. The instance role needs S3 access to the bucket. See [documentation]({docs_url}).

invalid_credentials.message: Bucket cannot be accessed. Check the access key ID and secret access key, or the IAM role permissions.

invalid_endpoint_url.message: Invalid endpoint URL. Please make sure it's a valid AWS S3 endpoint URL.
